posts.title: I Gave My CI a Tamagotchi
posts.dek: Meta open-sourced the Muse gadget SDK, and my Arduino UNO Q had an 8x13 LED matrix doing nothing but blink boot codes. Now a pixel creature lives there: it hops when CI goes green, sulks when a deploy fails, dozes when the board runs hot.

posts.title: Stop Training Forecast Models. Time Series Just Went Zero-Shot.
posts.dek: Mistral's Timestral can forecast a series it has never seen, on a CPU, in 140 milliseconds. That changes the build-vs-buy maths for every capacity, demand, and sensor dashboard you own.

posts.title: Your Repo Was Built for Humans. Your Agents Are the Users Now.
posts.dek: Anthropic just replaced Git because its agents merge 30,000 changes a day. You should not replace Git. But the pressure that forced their hand is already in your repo — here is where it shows up first.

posts.title: BM25 Is Eating Your Vector DB (And It Should)
posts.dek: A scaling study just said the boring algorithm wins. Here is when to believe it — and the 20-line baseline to test your own retriever.

posts.title: Your Agent's Failure Mode Is a Verification Problem, Not a Model Problem
posts.dek: Teams keep swapping models to fix flaky agents. The real bottleneck is that LLM outputs are probabilistic — and test suites assume they are not.
